title: Love in the Time of Cholera
author: Gabriel García Márquez
summary: Florentino Ariza falls in love as a young man with Fermina Daza, who marries a respected doctor. He waits more than fifty years for another chance, in a Caribbean port town.
readIf: you like lush, slow literary fiction about obsession and long-term love.
skipIf: you want a conventional romance, since the protagonist's behavior is often troubling.
